create.name: Langston Kahn
create.bio:
Based in New York City, Langston Kahn works as a shamanic practitioner and teacher; his work centres on emotional clearing, ancestral healing and personal transformation. He draws together several strands: Inner Relationship Focusing, the body-based listening method developed by Ann Weiser Cornell, which he has practised and taught for years; the contemporary shamanic training of Christina Pratt's Cycle of Transformation at the Last Mask Center, where he is now a senior teacher; and initiations into African diaspora traditions. He describes himself as a Black, queer teacher and sees his own helping spirits and ancestors as the thread that binds these sources together.

He sees clients in person and at a distance for shamanic healing, with a recording and integration steps after each session, and runs a five-session ancestral process that combines ritual, shrine tending and guided work with one's lineages. With Christina Pratt he teaches Energy Body Mastery, a recurring seven-week online course, and helps to lead the wider Last Mask Community. His book Deep Liberation, published by North Atlantic Books in 2021, sets out his approach for a general readership, and he leads workshops and talks both online and at venues such as the Omega Institute.

courses.title: Shamanic Healing Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions, in person in New York or at a distance, in which Langston journeys in trance with his helping spirits on the client's behalf. Each begins with a free 25-minute phone consultation, and clients receive a recording plus steps for integrating the work afterwards.
courses.price: No set fee; $300 USD suggested minimum

courses.title: Ancestral Liberation Sessions
courses.description: A package of five hour-long sessions for tending one's ancestral lines, starting with an assessment of the lineages involved. Between sessions there is ritual homework, shrine and offering practice, and email support.

courses.title: Energy Body Mastery
courses.description: A seven-week live online course run each year with Christina Pratt through the Last Mask Center, teaching the basic structures of the energy body and practices for grounding, boundaries and intuition. Classes are recorded, and Langston answers students' questions each week in a private forum.

free_resources.title: How to Start Shamanic Journeying
free_resources.description: A blog article in which Langston recalls his own early frustration with journeying and treats it as a learnable craft. He offers practical pointers for beginners.

free_resources.title: What is Emotional Clearing? (Video Interview)
free_resources.description: A recorded half-hour conversation, embedded on his blog, about how he came to body-based emotional clearing and what sets it apart. It ends with a short exercise for meeting an inner healer figure.
